bandReport.notes: COMPLETE. 24 questions, Q39-Q62, contiguous, no gaps. PER-PAGE RANGES: p07 = Q39-Q43 (5), p08 = Q44-Q48 (5), p09 = Q49-Q52 (4), p10 = Q53-Q58 (6), p11 = Q59-Q62 (4). Q39 opens cleanly at the top of p07's left column and continues nothing from p06 — B1 confirms Q38 closes on p06 with its option (d) as the last printed line. Q62 is COMPLETE on p11: its option (d) ends '...manufacturer of Sukhoi-30 MKI fighter.' as the last line of the right column, and nothing spills overleaf; Q63 begins on p12, which belongs to B3. THE ONE CROSS-BAND HAZARD IN THIS BAND, and it is internal to it: a 'Directions :' block at the top of p09's RIGHT column states 'The following three (3) items consist of two statements, Statement I and Statement II' and prints a SINGLE shared 'Code :'. It governs Q51, Q52 AND Q53 — and Q53 sits OVERLEAF on p10, where it prints Statement I and Statement II and NO options at all. The four code options have been copied into all three items and each carries a flag saying so. Anyone reading p10 alone would find Q53 optionless. No other Directions block appears in p07-p11, and no further Directions block is open at the p11/p12 boundary — Q62 is a self-contained four-option item, so B3 does not inherit a code from this band. FIVE MATCH-LIST / CODE questions here (Q41, Q42, Q44) plus the statement-code items; every code row was read individually at 9x. NOTABLE PATTERN worth passing to the other bands: this paper reuses ONE permutation pool across its Match Lists and merely shuffles which row carries which — Q34 (B1, p06), Q41 and Q44 all print the SAME four permutations {4231, 4321, 1234, 1324} in THREE DIFFERENT orders. That is precisely the shape that makes an inferred code row wrong, so each was read off the page in isolation. The all-options row sits at (d) in Q56 ('1, 2, 3 and 4') and is ABSENT from Q57 and Q58. PRINT DEFECTS: en-dashes in designations (T-55/T-72/T-90, Sukhoi-30 MKI) transcribed as plain hyphens; italic transliterations (Pahi-kashta, Zamindars, Lokapalas) transcribed as plain text since the italics are conventional rather than meaning-changing. Printed page numbers on this band are 14, 16, 18, 20, 22 — even, i.e. image n maps to printed 2n, not 2n+1.
